name: XCC_BALANCE_ACTIVITIES_HISTORY
description: This table stores Budgetary Control activities that have been purged from the regular XCC_BALANCE_ACTIVITIES table. Customers should save the contents of this table for audit purposes, but can feel free to archive them to some other storage location.

columns.name: AP_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Archive and purge process request identifier.

columns.name: PENDING_HEADER_GROUP_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total pending reservation amount for earlier transactions with same header group in current budgetary control request for this control budget, account, and period at time of funds reservation.

columns.name: HEADER_NUM
columns.description: Budgetary control transaction identifier.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Line number to uniquely identify the transaction line within the transaction.

columns.name: BALANCE_LINE_ORDER
columns.description: Balance line number. Uniquely identifies the activity within the transaction line.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Control budget impacted by this activity.

columns.name: CONTROL_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Control level that must be applied to this activity.  Valid values are ABSOLUTE, ADVISORY, TRACKING, and NONE.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Tolerance amount by which this activity can exceed funds. If both the tolerance amount and tolerance percent are available, the lesser tolerance of the two is used.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: Tolerance percent by which this activity can exceed funds. The tolerance percent is applied to the budget amount to get the actual tolerance. If both the tolerance amount and tolerance percent are available, the lesser tolerance of the two is used.

columns.name: ENTERED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of funds to consume, in the transaction line currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY
columns.description: Currency in which the transaction line is denominated.

columns.name: CONVERSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Conversion type to use for converting from the transaction line currency to the budget currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate to use for converting from the transaction line currency to the budget currency.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of funds to consume, in the budget currency.

columns.name: BUDGET_DATE
columns.description: Date on which to consume funds.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period in which to consume funds.

columns.name: BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Budget account for which to consume funds.

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Status of funds check or reservation for this particular balance activity.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether this is an original activity, a liquidation activity, or a backout activity.

columns.name: ALLOC_HEADER_NUM
columns.description: For liquidation activities, identifies the budgetary control header being liquidated. Otherwise, it is NULL.

columns.name: ALLOC_LINE_NUM
columns.description: For liquidation activities, identifies the budgetary control line being liquidated. Otherwise, it is NULL.

columns.name: BACKOUT_HEADER_NUM
columns.description: For backout activities, identifies the budgetary control header being undone or reversed. Otherwise, it is NULL.

columns.name: BACKOUT_LINE_NUM
columns.description: For backout activities, identifies the budgetary control line being undone or reversed. Otherwise, it is NULL.

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of balance impacted by this activity. Some examples are commitment, obligation, and budget.

columns.name: SUB_BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of balance impacted by this activity, tracked at a more detailed level. Some examples are approved commitment, approved obligation, accounted payables, and accounted receipts.

columns.name: BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Initial amount budgeted to this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds validation. Add the budget adjustment amount to get the total budget.

columns.name: BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount by which the budgeted amount has been increased or decreased for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds validation. Add the initial budget amount to get the total budget.

columns.name: COMMITMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds committed for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds validation.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds obligated for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds validation.

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds spent for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds validation.

columns.name: OTHER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Expenditures other than funds spent, funds committed, and funds obligated for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds validation.

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAILABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total funds available for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds validation. It is equal to the total budget minus the total expenditures.

columns.name: PENDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total pending reservations from earlier transactions for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds validation.

columns.name: OTHER_LINES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total pending reservations from earlier lines in this transaction for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds validation.

columns.name: NET_TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Tolerance amount by which this activity can exceed funds. Calculated based on the least of the TOLERANCE_AMOUNT and the TOLERANCE_PERCENT. This column does not track the tolerance that was actually used; it just tracks the tolerance that was available.

columns.name: PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Project Management expenditure type identifier. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: PJC_TOP_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Project Management top resource identifier being burdened against. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: PJC_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Project Management lowest resource identifier being burdened against. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: General ledger account associated with this activity. It is only populated for burdening activities, as they can override the line level account.

columns.name: LEDGER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of funds to consume, in the ledger currency. It is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: BURDEN_LINE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this activity originated from burdening. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_CLOSED_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether closed period override is being considered for an activity. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_FUNDS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether insufficient funds override is being considered for an activity. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated tolerance amount needed for funds validation to pass.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated override amount needed for funds validation to pass.

columns.name: PERIOD_CHANGE_FOR_UNDO_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the data is reversed into a different period.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FOR_ESSBASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether balances have been transferred to the budget cube for this control budget and period name combination.

columns.name: BALANCES_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether control budget balance is impacted. Valid values are Y, N, and NULL.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
